description: Defines API classes for accessing and manipulating HTTP headers in a version-agnostic way, supporting both HTTP/1 and HTTP/2 headers. Includes classes ConstHeaderApi and HeaderApi with methods for header retrieval, modification, and inspection.

classes.name: ConstHeaderApi
classes.description: Interface for read-only access to HTTP headers, supporting operations like header lookup, existence checks, and string representation.

classes.name: HeaderApi
classes.description: Extends ConstHeaderApi with methods for modifying headers, such as appending, replacing, and removing headers.

methods.name: GetHeader
methods.description: Retrieves the first header value for a given key.

methods.name: GetAllOfHeader
methods.description: Retrieves all header values for a given key.

methods.name: HasHeader
methods.description: Checks if a header with the specified key exists.

methods.name: HeaderHasValue
methods.description: Checks if a header with the specified key has a specific value.

methods.name: GetAllOfHeaderAsString
methods.description: Joins all header values for a key into a comma-separated string.

methods.name: ReplaceOrAppendHeader
methods.description: Replaces existing header or appends a new one.

methods.name: RemoveAllOfHeader
methods.description: Removes all headers with a specific key.

methods.name: AppendHeader
methods.description: Appends a new header with specified key and value.
